Sarasota Performing Arts — February 2027

Updated Wednesday, November 25, 2026, 3:45 AM ET

Filter venues

Summary

Summary

Back to top ↑

February is a packed winter-season month: 270 performances of 59 productions, at 15 venues in three areas — Sarasota, Venice, and Bradenton. Every day has at least one show posted. No official Lakewood Ranch listings were found.

Highlights

Sarasota Opera’s Winter Festival opens with La traviata on February 6 (six performances through February 26), followed by H.M.S. Pinafore from February 13 and Ariadne auf Naxos on February 27. Single-ticket prices were not posted for the festival.

Theatre (116) stays busy. Florida Studio Theatre premieres Upgrade on February 3 and Laughing Matters on February 10, and keeps American Rebels in the cabaret all month. Asolo Rep closes Ma Rainey’s Black Bottom on February 4 and opens The Royal Family on February 10. Westcoast Black Theatre Troupe’s A Midsummer Night’s Dream runs through February 21, and Urbanite’s The Garbologists continues through February 14 ($5–$52).

Broadway at the Van Wezel includes Shucked (February 8–9), Water for Elephants (February 12–14), and Waitress (February 23–25). The Sarasota Orchestra presents Carmina Burana on February 5–7 and Bernstein & Barber on February 19–21 (both from $43). Alvin Ailey is at the Van Wezel on February 11, the Ballet presents the Paul Taylor Dance Company on February 26–28, and Circus Sarasota 2027 plays The Big Top February 19–28 (from $30).

Don’t miss, and the busy days

The opening week, February 1–7, is the busiest (79 performances). Saturday the 6th — opening night of La traviata, with Carmina Burana still in town — is one of two peak days (17 performances), tied with February 13, when H.M.S. Pinafore begins. Circus Sarasota opens February 19, the same weekend as Bernstein & Barber.

Free and low-cost

Van Wezel’s All Abilities Dance Workshop on February 19 at 5:30 PM is free. Other verified low-cost options include the Venice Concert Band on February 22 ($17), The Venice Chorale on February 28 ($25), Urbanite student tickets at $5, and National Theatre Live at the Ringling on February 18–19 ($20, or $15 for members and $10 for students).

Still to be listed

Venice Theatre has announced Kinky Boots (February 19–March 14), The Players Centre has announced The Importance of Being Earnest on eight February dates, and Manatee Performing Arts Center has announced The Soul Sensations (February 9–13) and Appropriate (February 18–28), all without daily showtimes, so those runs are not given rows here. The Jazz Club lists “Feb 20 Dave Bennett La Lucha” with tickets TBA, but no official event page with a time or venue had been posted. Prices are left blank on 174 performances where official pages did not state them, including the FST, Asolo, and WBTT runs, and the opera festival.

About this listing

  • Built from official venue and organization sites and the ticket calendars they use, for February 1–28, 2027 only. Checked Sunday, November 22, 2026. Prices and times are left blank when an official source does not post them. Secondary calendars were not used for showtimes.
  • Florida Studio Theatre individual dates and times come from the official ticketing calendars for The Bully Pulpit (through February 14), Sailing: Yacht Rock and Beyond (through February 7), American Rebels, Imagination Rocks! (February 7 at 10:00 AM), the world premiere of Upgrade (from February 3), and Laughing Matters (from February 10). Ticket prices were not cleanly posted on those official marketing or ticketing pages, so the price column is left blank. Official running times are posted for The Bully Pulpit (120 minutes with a 15-minute intermission), Imagination Rocks! (50 minutes, no intermission), Upgrade (90 minutes, no intermission), and Laughing Matters (90 minutes with a 15-minute intermission).
  • Van Wezel showtimes follow the official event detail pages, which are used in preference to the all-events summary dates when the two differ. Ticket ranges are listed low to high when the hall posts a high-to-low range. Masterworks: Carmina Burana (February 5–7) and Masterworks: Bernstein & Barber (February 19–21) are at the Van Wezel; tickets are sold by the Sarasota Orchestra, from $43, with a posted running time of two hours including intermission. Official Masterclass: Waitress is February 24 at 11:00 AM only. Official Golden Groovers: The Music of Neil Young is February 25 at 2:00 PM only. The free All Abilities Dance Workshop: Ballroom Dance is February 19 at 5:30 PM only.
  • Sarasota Concert Association presents pianist Aristo Sham on February 3 at 7:30 PM at Riverview Performing Arts Center, 1 Ram Way; Orpheus Chamber Orchestra with Isata Kanneh-Mason on February 15 at 7:30 PM at the Van Wezel; and Midori with Festival Strings Lucerne on February 28 at 2:00 PM at the Van Wezel. Tickets for those three concerts are sold by the Association, not by the halls.
  • Sarasota Opera’s 2027 Winter Festival listings follow the official homepage upcoming-events calendar: La traviata (February 6, 9, 11, 14 at 1:30 PM, 20 at 1:30 PM, and 26), H.M.S. Pinafore (February 13, 16, 18, 21 at 1:30 PM, and 28 at 1:30 PM), Ariadne auf Naxos (February 27), the Artists’ Choice Concert (February 20 at 7:30 PM), and a Moonlight & Melodies courtyard dinner (February 17 at 6:30 PM). Evening opera performances are at 7:30 PM except where a matinee time is listed. Single-ticket prices were not posted on that calendar. The 2026–27 season announcement and a season brochure also listed a February 24 evening performance of H.M.S. Pinafore that does not appear on the current official upcoming-events calendar, so it is omitted here.
  • Asolo Repertory Theatre times for August Wilson’s Ma Rainey’s Black Bottom (through February 4) and The Royal Family (February 10–March 4; February dates only) come from the official show pages. Single-ticket prices were not posted there. Both are in the Mertz Theatre.
  • Westcoast Black Theatre Troupe’s official A Midsummer Night’s Dream calendar runs through February 21. February dates and times follow that page. Ticket prices were not posted. The next official production, Beehive – The 60s Musical, opens March 3.
  • Urbanite Theatre’s The Garbologists continues through February 14. Remaining February dates follow the official weekly pattern (Wednesday 2:00 PM and 7:30 PM; Thursday, Friday, and Saturday 7:30 PM; Sunday 2:00 PM). Official ticket categories are Standard $52, Under 40 $32, and Student $5.
  • Venice Theatre times for Catfish Moon and Blood of the Lamb (both through February 7) follow the official event pages: Tuesday–Saturday 7:30 PM and Sunday 2:00 PM. Official prices are $19 youth, $30 college and educators, and $40 adult and seniors. The official events calendar also lists a Showtime Benefit for Student Scholarships on February 27 at 2:00 PM (tickets not yet on sale when checked). Kinky Boots is announced for February 19–March 14, but that listing did not yet post individual daily showtimes or put tickets on sale, so it is not given rows here.
  • Venice Performing Arts Center listings follow official event pages, including all three posted Romantic Rendezvous performances (February 5 at 7:30 PM and February 6 at 3:30 PM and 7:30 PM) and all three posted New World Journey performances (February 26 at 7:30 PM and February 27 at 3:30 PM and 7:30 PM). The Venice Chorale’s Musical Road Map of America is February 28 at 7:00 PM, $25, also listed on the chorale’s official season page.
  • Manatee Performing Arts Center listings with official individual times are Blue Violin (February 3, 7:00 PM; price not posted), The Women of Rock (February 6, 7:00 PM; price not posted), and Celebrate Valentine’s Day with Ariella & Nicolaas (dinner at 6:00 PM, show at 7:00 PM, $178.50 including a buffet). The official announcement also lists The Soul Sensations, February 9–13, starting at $38 / $20.25, and Appropriate, February 18–28, $32.50 adult / $17.50 student, educator, or active military, without individual daily showtimes, so those two productions are not given rows here.
  • The Players Centre has announced The Importance of Being Earnest for February 6, 7, 13, 14, 20, 21, 27, and 28 at 1400 Blvd. of the Arts, Suite 200, but the official 97th-season page does not post individual daily times, so the production is not given rows here.
  • The Sarasota Ballet’s Program Four includes an official February 1 performance at 7:30 PM at the FSU Center for the Performing Arts, $35–$145. Program Five, presenting the Paul Taylor Dance Company, is February 26–28 (March 1 omitted), also $35–$145, at the FSU Center.
  • Circus Sarasota 2027 official times at The Big Top at the UTC Mall (191 University Town Center Dr) follow the Circus Arts Conservatory ticket page, from $30, with a posted running time of two hours including a 15-minute intermission. February 19–28 dates only are listed. A Circus Arts Gala on February 5 at the Big Top is a fundraising event and is omitted from the timetable.
  • The Ringling official event pages: Agrupación Señor Serrano’s Birdie at the Historic Asolo Theater on February 10 and 11 at 7:30 PM ($40); and National Theatre Live: Les Liaisons Dangereuses on February 18 at 6:30 PM and February 19 at 1:00 PM ($20 / $15 members / $10 students; posted running time of three hours).
  • Artist Series Concerts official event pages: Ehnes and Lark on February 9 at 7:30 PM at First Congregational United Church of Christ, 1031 S. Euclid Ave ($60 general admission / $100 VIP; $10 student tickets at the door); and Bach in the Americas on February 16 at 5:30 PM at Marie Selby Botanical Gardens, 1534 Mound Street ($50; tickets in advance).
  • The Jazz Club of Sarasota official homepage lists “Feb 20 Dave Bennett La Lucha” among upcoming shows with tickets TBA, but no official February event page with a time or venue had been posted when checked. The official 2027 Sarasota Jazz Festival is March 14–20, outside this listing. Dates that appear only on secondary calendars are omitted.
  • No official February 2027 concert listings were found for Via Nova Chorale, the Sarasota Choral Society, Key Chorale (apart from any earlier Cirque des Voix collaboration), New College / Mildred Sainer Pavilion, the Sarasota Music Festival or Conservatory, SCF Neel Performing Arts Center, or additional Sarasota Orchestra Holley Hall chamber concerts beyond the Van Wezel Masterworks already listed. The Chorus of the Keys official site lists Singing Valentines on February 14 and 15 and an annual show on March 6; the valentines are not a public concert and are omitted. No official Lakewood Ranch listings were found.
  • Days in February with nothing posted at these venues are omitted from the timetable.
